title.tr: Tavana kadar beyaz boyalı çok kapaklı gömme dolap
title.en: Floor-to-ceiling white painted built-in wardrobe with many doors

alt.tr: Tavana kadar uzanan beyaz boyalı, alt ve üst kapaklı gömme dolap; metal kulplar, parke zemin
alt.en: A white painted built-in wardrobe reaching the ceiling, with lower and upper doors, metal handles and a parquet floor

caption.tr: Dolap duvardan tavana kadar tek yüzey gibi görünüyor. Altta dört, üstte dört kapak, hepsi ince metal kulplu.
caption.en: The wardrobe looks like a single surface from wall to ceiling. There are four doors below and four above, all with slim metal handles.
